bundle_summary: Two defensible directions emerge: (1) personalized photo-based visor clip accessories, supported by two near-identical long-tail queries; (2) cute/feminine car accessories, especially rear-view mirror items and seat covers, supported by multiple audience/style queries. Broad product surfaces and generic gift terms are held as ingredients. One named-IP candidate is quarantined.
bundle_warnings: Named IP detected and quarantined: 21 pilots merch
Many entries are generic product surfaces or broad occasions; treated as ingredients only
Some long-tail items have low clicks; validation should confirm meaningful demand before advancement
